scope: Owner-approved common comparative standards for weekly nomination forecasts, plus an explicitly hypothetical assessment of McEntee’s potential constituency. No full wargame or numerical update.
summary: Require the same entry, resource, coalition, liability and uncertainty standards across all eight contenders before weekly weighting. Narrative attention and correct arithmetic do not establish comparable treatment.
changes: Require a comparison_review for future weekly full games, covering all authorized candidates and actual scenario ranges.
Require cross-candidate consistency challenges covering everyone and a check against user framing, incumbency and missing-coverage bias.
Keep historical forecasts, current estimates and the weekly-full/daily-monitor cadence unchanged.

mcentee_base_hypothesis.status: Analytical hypothesis; no verified nomination polling or demographic composition.
mcentee_base_hypothesis.potential_core: Trump-aligned voters seeking younger leadership and continuity with the movement’s original priorities, including culturally conservative online audiences. This is a potential constituency, not established support.
mcentee_base_hypothesis.potential_extension: Nationalist voters attracted to immigration restriction, less foreign intervention and more control over executive staffing, conditional on current positions and electoral credibility. Do not treat this as Paul/Massie’s entire constituency or infer libertarian views from withdrawal work.
mcentee_base_hypothesis.organizational_assets: Personnel and transition relationships can be mobilizable resources. They are not a voter base, delegate operation, faction endorsement or guaranteed campaign support.
mcentee_base_hypothesis.overlap: The potential constituency may overlap substantially with Trump/Vance voters. Loyalty to Trump could also keep those voters with Trump’s preferred successor.
mcentee_base_hypothesis.countercase: Online familiarity can remain entertainment; current insider and business ties can weaken a renewal argument; contenders may never enter or mobilize delegates.
what_would_test_it: Comparable nomination polling including McEntee and second-choice preferences.
Verified audience composition and favorable interest beyond engagement counts.
Actual endorsements, organizers and political funding distinct from business relationships.
Evidence of how Trump-aligned voters respond to his independent positioning.

sources.status: Own biography; supports self-presentation and relationships, not independent popularity.
Own promotional page; supports intended cultural/media positioning, not verified vote conversion.
Original 2023 organizational announcement; no 2028 endorsement inferred.

next_application: Next full weekly review; daily monitoring queues evidence without rerunning the comparative forecast.
validation: 54 Python integrity/workflow tests passed, plus 6 selector tests, lint, production build and database validation. CI browser checks and live revision verification follow publication. Structural validation does not establish analytical truth.
